text.aria-label: Title text 'Lagged power in the calibrator scores as low as any arm at every lead for the Primary substations'

g.text: Lagged power in the calibrator scores as low as any arm at every lead for the Primary substations

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the 9-quantile forecast, an estimate of the continuous ranked probability score, in points of the substation's capacity (smaller is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is. Stage 1 is an XGBoost model that maps ECMWF ensemble weather (51 members) to demand; the calibrator is a second XGBoost model that turns the 51 forecasts into 9 quantiles. Lagged power means recent observed demand. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Lagged power uses ERA5 weather at past times, so these arms are an upper bound on what production can do. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.'
